# CML-07 S2 Artifact Types Implementation Layering

Layer value is the decision unlocked, visible outcome, and risk reduced. Layer cost is authoring, verification, and coordination. Each boundary ends at the smallest slice that unlocks the next responsible decision.

| Layer | Decision question | Minimum working unit | Outcome | Risk reduced | Promotion |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `S2-L0` | After this layer, we know whether Product and Project can be represented as separate identity carriers without directory or cross-field inference. | Closed Product Identity and Project Identity schemas with positive projections and four hostile fixtures. | Independent Product and Project machine contracts. | Product-Project collapse and directory-derived identity. | Continue when both identities and schemas remain pairwise distinct. |
| `S2-L1` | After this layer, we know whether applied Method and intended Goal remain independent from their subjects and validation state. | Closed Method Binding and Goal schemas with endpoint and achievement non-inference tests. | Explicit Method application and Goal outcome contracts. | Method-endpoint collapse and validation-as-achievement. | Continue when bindings and goals add no inferred authority or achievement. |
| `S2-L2` | After this layer, we know whether cross-identity relations and same-Product rename lineage can be represented explicitly without collapsing endpoints or Context lineage. | Closed Identity Graph and Identity Lineage schemas with endpoint, signature, duplicate, and substitution tests. | Typed relationship and Product-lineage contracts. | Unresolved endpoints, invalid relation signatures, duplicate identity axes, and lineage substitution. | Continue when all endpoints and lineage roles stay distinct. |
| `S2-L3` | After this layer, we know whether all six Artifact Types form one dependency-closed, repeatable candidate cohort. | Aggregate 16-check suite over six type receipts and thirteen hostile fixtures. | One reviewable S2 cohort. | Partial success, missing type coverage, and claim inflation. | Request one digest-bound admission decision before S3. |

## Non-regression guardrails

- Machine artifacts and instances remain canonical; human projections remain generated.
- All six Artifact Type, schema, and instance identity fields remain pairwise distinct.
- Dependent identities are explicit references or typed relations and never inferred from labels or directories.
- Validation PASS and candidate schema conformance do not imply admission, identity-contract conformance, implementation conformance, runtime conformance, or Goal achievement.
- Candidate 0006, candidate 0007, Artifact Type/v2, decision 0029, and chain 0002 remain byte-preserved predecessors.
